Docs.summary: Exposes the of a that .NET MAUI uses to fill an area with an image.

remarks.para: This is a consumption-only contract. It exists so that code receiving a - most commonly a platform backend handling - can recognize an image background and read its image source without reflection.

Implementing this interface outside of .NET MAUI is not supported. .NET MAUI reserves the right to add members to this interface in future releases, which would be a breaking change for external implementers. Only paints created by .NET MAUI are guaranteed to be recognized and rendered by the built-in handlers; a custom implementing this interface is not guaranteed to be honored, because not every built-in handler routes backgrounds through the image-source path.

Values implementing this interface are obtained by pattern matching an existing , typically from . In .NET MAUI a paint of this kind is produced when a background is set from an image - for example a Microsoft.Maui.Controls.ImageBrush, or Page.BackgroundImageSource.

can be , which represents an image background with nothing to draw. Treat it the same as having no image background: clear any previously applied image rather than attempting to resolve it. A non- value should be resolved through an ; note that resolution is asynchronous and may still yield no image.

This is distinct from . carries an already-loaded for drawing operations, whereas this contract carries an unresolved that describes where an image comes from (a file, URI, stream, or font glyph) and must be loaded through an image source service. A paint will not implement both.
